context: A three-way meeting at the office. Hiroshi (boss), Kenji (senior subordinate), and Yuki (junior). The boss is laying out a difficult project; Yuki has been promoted into a leadership role on it.
purpose: three-way workplace formality — assignment and quiet support

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 佐藤くん、田中さん、お時間ありがとう。
lines.en: Sato, Ms. Tanaka — thank you for making the time.
lines.style: Measured opening from the head of the table. No ceremony, clean enunciation. Voice carries quiet authority without striving for it. Respectful pause between names.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Brief, automatic professional response. The bow integral to the breath — not separate. Registers as present without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: Yes, thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Genuine junior politeness delivered without strain. Careful enunciation on the gratitude. Holds steady eye-contact level in her voice — neither deferring nor presuming.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この案件、田中さんに、リードしてもらいたい。
lines.en: On this project — Ms. Tanaka, I want you to lead it.
lines.style: Direct hand-off without preamble. Simple declarative. The word 「lead」 lands with quiet certainty. No softening, no apology for the assignment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Small startled lift on the opening. Voice catches briefly upward in genuine surprise. Hands move instinctively — the sound carries that impulse.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。本当に、君に任せたい。
lines.en: Yes. I genuinely want you to take this on.
lines.style: The 「本当に」 rare from Hiroshi — it lands heavy. Warm but unadorned. Slight emphasis on 「genuinely」. No rush, full presence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いい話ですね。私も、後ろから支えます。
lines.en: That's wonderful news. I'll support you from here.
lines.style: Small warm senior-colleague reassurance. Steady, attentive presence underneath. Not rushing to fill space — letting Yuki's moment land before he claims his own part of it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お二人、本当にありがとうございます。
lines.en: Both of you — thank you so much.
lines.style: Real bow inside the voice. Breath catches slightly on gratitude — not broken, but reaching. Voice carries the weight of being trusted. Small trailing breath at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一緒に、進めよう。大変だが、できる。
lines.en: Let's move forward together. It's demanding — but we can do it.
lines.style: Firm small encouragement from the head. No rush, no pressure. The pauses matter. Voice settles into conviction without needing to prove it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I'll match my schedule to yours.
lines.style: Parallel commitment delivered with full presence. Not rushed, not performative. The voice carries the weight of meaning what he says — a second layer of support.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 頑張ります。本当に、頑張ります。
lines.en: I'll give my best. Truly — my absolute best.
lines.style: Doubled commitment, deliberate and steady. The repetition is not emphasis but sincerity. Voice holds firm. No apology, no hedging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Closing line, slight bow integral to the delivery. Simple, spare. The weight of that trust transmits in the quiet. Breath settles at the end.
